dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature forming a smooth inward-sweeping spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as rounded-acute, forming a tight pixel radius at the maximum vertical projection.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a convex slope at approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin displays a wide-based profile with a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1.3:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon displays a continuous, large-radius convex arc forming a blunt, rounded cephalic profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small circular pale lesion is visible on the mid-posterior section of the dorsal fin; faint horizontal linear marks are present on the lower lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region lacks a distinct rostrum, terminating in a blunt snout; a well-defined tri-coloration boundary is visible between the dark dorsal cape and the lighter grey flank.
